title: Require the pull_request CI contexts on dev (OPAG-462 AC2)
description: quest-cli's share of opum-agent OPAG-462 AC2. dev had no required-checks rule (rules/branches/dev read []). The three contexts that run unfiltered on every pull_request into dev are required there, added append-only under this repository's grant 2026-09-11-ci-rollout-quest-cli (modify-branch-ruleset, opum-ai/quest-cli, expires 2026-12-10, not revoked; read from opum-doc dev e288304), only after each had reported green on dev, with 0 bypass actors.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A ruleset on refs/heads/dev requires source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check, with 0 bypass actors, read back from gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/rules/branches/dev
Each context had reported success on the dev tip before the ruleset was created
The CLAUDE.md branch-protection profile states the new dev rule

finalSummary: Created ruleset require-ci-on-dev, id 24063809, on refs/heads/dev. It is active with 0 bypass actors, strict policy off and do_not_enforce_on_create off, and it requires source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check. That is the same three-context shape as require-ci-on-main (22833771), which is unchanged. AUTHORITY: grant 2026-09-11-ci-rollout-quest-cli, read by this session from opum-doc grants/ at dev e288304, not from the relay. It names modify-branch-ruleset on opum-ai/quest-cli, expires 2026-12-10T14:00:00Z, and is not revoked. The change is an append-only addition of required contexts, which is within its stated spirit. PRECONDITION measured before creation: all three read completed/success on the dev tip 3bd59d7, and all three fire unfiltered on pull_request into dev (lore-check.yml and tracker-integrity.yml have branches [dev, main]; prepublication-qualification.yml has main and dev). READ BACK: gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/rules/branches/dev returns one required_status_checks rule, ruleset_id 24063809, with the three contexts. The first merge under it was PR #327 (QCLI-394), which went green on all three and squash-merged. The CLAUDE.md branch-protection profile now records the dev rule and marks the 2026-09-11 "no required checks configured" text as superseded.
